tags.title: Anguish & Conflict Front Line - Love Is A Life-Or-Death Game
tags.lyrics-eng:
I’m a radio wave from your whim
I dance love samba with joy
It’s too late when I realize it
I’m a spon-spon while I’m watching I want to kill you with my own two hands

I want to kill you!
I’m a beam beam beam!
The name is the final battle strategy!

I’m the only one who’s naked!
I’m the only one who’s naked! I’m the only one who’s naked!
I’m so angry that I can’t even speak to you!
But if you die, this feeling of death will reach you!
My telepathy! I want to kill you!
After all, you live, live!
I live for you, live!
But do you forget about me?
Do you forget about me?

Ah...

Otatsuhaite Yano!
Ando na nanana!
Otatsuhaite Yano!
Ando na nanana!
Otatsuhaite Yano!
Ando na nanana!
Honkatsu daitesete!
Koi wa yasuyoke!

Someday, I will sing a love love song for you
I can’t hear you, I can’t reach you, I can’t see anything
Someday, I will dance a love love samba with you
Ah, I’m so crazy
I want to be with you forever 届け!

届け!

届け!
